title: Alacritty quits on launch
author: triallax
body:
Alacritty immediately quits on launch, before even showing the window. Neither reinstalling Alacritty nor restarting the machine seems to help. I deleted my Alacritty config file and that didn't fix anything, so my config has nothing to do with this issue.

### System

OS: macOS 12.6
Version: alacritty 0.11.0 (8dbaa0b)

### Logs
